_readme: Every sound and music track the game asks ElevenLabs for. scripts/gen-audio.py reads
this; the 'Generate audio' GitHub Action (manual only) runs it. A sound is generated
only if its file is missing or its prompt/settings changed, so re-runs cost nothing
for sounds that already exist. Keep prompts under ~380 characters (longer ones get
rejected), and SFX durations between 0.5 and 22 seconds.
id = the file name (public/audio/<id>.mp3) and the name the game plays it by.
'supplied' = files we already own (from the Beyond Extinction Godot repo, audio/supplied/). They cost no credits: the script just trims, levels and compresses them.

sfx.prompt: Soft cartoon pop, a tiny snack box picked up, bright, light and short. Cute casual mobile game UI sound. No music.
Small soft wooden thunk of a little cardboard box set down onto a stack. Cartoon casual mobile game sound, short and clean.
One bright coin clink, a single coin collected. Cheerful casual mobile game pickup sound, very short.
Cheerful cash register ka-ching with a little bell, short. Cozy casual mobile tycoon game sale sound.
A tiny quick coin tick, one short metallic click of a coin dropping into a pile. Very short and soft.
Bright magical unlock fanfare: short rising chime with sparkles and a soft pop. Cozy casual mobile tycoon game, new building unlocked.
Triumphant level up jingle with short brass, bells and sparkle, cheerful and celebratory. Casual mobile game.
Power-up upgrade sound: a quick rising whoosh into a sparkly ding. Casual mobile tycoon game.
Positive arcade whoosh through a glowing gate ending in a bright ding. Upbeat runner game bonus sound.
Negative arcade penalty: a low buzz with a deflating wobble. Runner game, playful not scary.
Short arcade warning: two quick alert pings, caution ahead. Playful runner game sound.
Reward celebration: a small crowd cheering with a short victory fanfare and a confetti pop. Casual mobile game.
Arcade race start: three short countdown beeps then one higher go beep. Clean, no voice.
Small metal trash can lid clang with a bit of junk dropping in. Cartoon, short.
Soft bubbly UI pop for a menu or card opening. Gentle, short, casual mobile game.
Cozy reward: coins pouring into a pile with a warm chime. Idle game offline earnings collected.
Small propeller airplane engine revving up, rolling down a runway and taking off, flying away into the distance.
Helicopter rotor blades thumping as it lifts off and flies away. Outdoor.
Friendly tour boat horn, two short toots at a harbor. Outdoor, light seagull ambience.
Volcano eruption: deep rumbling boom, ground shaking, rocks crackling and lava hissing.
A flaming rock whistling down from the sky and crashing with a fiery thud and sizzle.
Hotel front desk service bell, one crisp ding. Clean, no room noise.
Rolling thunder crack followed by rain starting to fall. Outdoor storm.
Creepy cartoon spider hiss with quick skittering legs. Spooky but fun, short.

music.prompt: Cozy, bouncy instrumental for a cute ant colony idle tycoon game. Plucky pizzicato strings, marimba, light hand percussion and a playful bassoon melody. Cheerful and busy like tiny workers marching. Mid tempo. Loopable, no vocals.

Smooth relaxed bossa nova lounge instrumental for an airport terminal in a casual tycoon game. Nylon guitar, soft electric piano, brushed drums and upright bass. Bright and friendly. Loopable, no vocals.
Tense adventurous instrumental for an active volcano level in a casual game. Deep tribal drums, low brass and rumbling percussion with a heroic edge. Driving rhythm, not scary. Loopable, no vocals.
Elegant hotel lobby jazz instrumental for a 5-star resort in a cozy tycoon game. Light swing piano trio with soft vibraphone. Classy, warm and cheerful. Loopable, no vocals.
Upbeat energetic chase instrumental for an arcade runner mini-game. Fast funky drums, slap bass, bright synth brass stabs and a catchy hook. Fun and exciting. Loopable, no vocals.
